L11·N9164unmasked layer
Fires at document-internal segment breaks — almost always the newline token right after a sentence-final period (or an end-of-name token like "!"/"pace"), i.e., the boundary between two unrelated scraped sentences/listing lines; note that other newlines in coherent continuous prose drive it strongly negative, so it is a newline-position feature discriminating fragment boundaries.
